title: oldenlandia stricta subsp. arenaria
intro: Oldenlandia stricta subsp. arenaria, commonly known as coastal creeping Oldenlandia, is a plant species found in coastal areas of Southeast Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Oldenlandia stricta subsp. arenaria are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant properties, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been shown to possess anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties.
